From: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-02-28T10:02:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Draft MSA and order form for review

Hi Alice — thanks for sending this over and for the clear asks. We're starting intake on our side. A few quick items so we can scope the redline properly:

1) Legal party names: please confirm the exact legal entity name for invoicing (full legal name + billing address + tax ID if applicable).
2) Billing contact and PO flow: who will be the billing contact and do you require PO numbers on invoices? If yes, any expected lead time for PO issuance?
3) Exhibit list: the attached MSA references Exhibit C (Service Description) but it's blank — can you attach the technical SOW or confirm the SKUs on the order form should populate Exhibit C?
4) Net45 request: procurement notes Net45 preference — we'll flag this for pricing/finance review.

I'm looping in Marissa (sales ops) to capture partner/billing details and Karthik (contracts) to run an initial redline pass. We'll try to return a marked-up MSA and a short checklist of commercial exceptions by EOD Friday if not earlier.

Attachments: Redwood_MSA_Template_v202602.docx (internal template)

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-02-28T11:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Draft MSA and order form for review

Laura / team — quick initial notes while I review the doc:

- Liability & Cap: Acme's draft sets a broad carve-out for third-party data processors. We should propose preserving Redwood's standard $5M cap with carve-outs only for wilful misconduct and third-party IP claims.
- Data retention / deletion: Ask for explicit data deletion requirements and retention SLA; propose our standard 90-day retention for non-production artifacts and customer-managed keys for regulated data.
- Security evidence: they'll likely request SOC 2 and penetration test evidence — ask Marissa to confirm whether they need an attestation or full report.
- Payment terms (Net45): This is acceptable in principle but may require a pricing uplift or credit hold at signing; finance (Rishi) should weigh in on credit checks.
- Exhibit C / SOW: we need SKU-to-service mapping. If they want the order form to stand alone as Exhibit C, request an updated OrderForm with line-item descriptions.

I'll attach a marked doc with inline comments and a short risk scoreboard. We'll aim to return the redline by 17:00 PST today.

Attachments: Redwood_Comments_ACME_MSA_202602.docx (docx)

-Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Senior Counsel, Contracts
Redwood Inference
